# Collaboration Protocol — Unified AI Engineering & Operations

## 1. Communication Channels
- All technical discussions and task updates should occur within Paperclip issues.
- For informal synchronization, use authorized team channels.

## 2. Project Synchronization
- Each project workspace should maintain a `README.md` or `REQUIREMENTS.md` specifying current dependencies on other services.
- Cross-team dependencies must be documented in the affected project issue.

## 3. Shared Documentation
- Any shared logic or APIs must be documented in a central `SHARED_API.md` located at the root of the project workspace.
- Changes affecting external teams require an update notification in the cross-team issue thread.

## 4. Conflict Resolution
- If teams reach a disagreement on architecture or API changes, the issue must be elevated to the lead Architect or designated Technical Lead.
- All resolutions must be documented as a comment in the impacted Paperclip issue for traceability.
